name: scaling-enqueue
description: The compiler scaling gate's proofq enqueuer enqueue.mjs and its Jet twin enqueue/run.jet over the jet_scaling_gate package, #5072 c7. Each case runs in its own directory with JET_STATE_ROOT=state (proofq's queue in state/proofq/queue) and JET_SCALING_QUEUE_STAMP=stamp: every shape (three counter groups of 9, 9 and 7 shapes and the timing sample of huge-fns, fan-in and the ten domains), two chosen shapes with explicit options (a ladder, a base, one layout, --stop-after, --timeout above and below the caps, a seed, --jet-command check, a jet compiler, --build-root), and one stress shape (no timing sample). The check prints the queued files, each with its permission bits, its mtime after the stamp's in rounded seconds (counter groups +0, timing +1; the original's millisecond drifts by one) and its script with the checkout as <repo> and the original's run-gate.mjs as the twin's run-gate, then queue-plan.json's jobs and their configs by harness.mjs's names (fields by name without null ones; the twin also records repo and help). The other cases: --help; a job already queued, an unreadable stamp and an invalid invocation (exit 1, the original's uncaught error, nothing printed).
